prompts.council-frame:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG website UI border-image asset, one standalone council notice-board FRAME ONLY.
Primary request: Create a wide 3:2 rectangular wooden-and-stone council notice-board frame in the recognizable Clash of Clans chunky stylized 3D game interface aesthetic. Render at 1536x1024 or equivalent 3:2 landscape ratio. Orthographic, perfectly straight-on front view; perfectly horizontal and vertical edges, no perspective or tilt. Thick clean chunky bevel perimeter in caramel golden oak, cool slate stone corner blocks, restrained bronze inset rim, a few metal corner rivets. Soft bright game-render lighting, tasteful scuffs and broad smooth modeled surfaces.
Composition: frame nearly fills canvas with a narrow transparent margin. The perimeter is approximately 9 percent of canvas width on each edge. The central opening must be a large completely empty TRANSPARENT RECTANGULAR HOLE, at least 70 percent of canvas width AND 70 percent of canvas height. This is a hollow picture-frame-like border, with NO board, wood, parchment, stone, or opaque fill in the center. Both the entire center hole and the outside of the perimeter must have genuine alpha transparency. Keep edges clean for use as CSS border-image framing readable web text.
Constraints: one frame only. NO scenery, background, backdrop, floor, drop shadow on an opaque plane, checkerboard drawn in image, text, lettering, logos, symbols, people, swords, shields, torches, flags, decorative characters, or additional objects. Do not fill the center. Transparent background AND transparent center are essential.
prompts.clan-banner:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG website UI asset, one standalone blank clan banner / shield placard for names, photos and sponsor logos later overlaid in HTML.
Primary request: Create a vertical medieval clan banner / shield placard in the recognizable Clash of Clans chunky stylized 3D game interface aesthetic. Portrait aspect ratio approximately 3:4. Orthographic perfectly straight-on front view with no tilt or perspective. A simple shape with flat broad horizontal top, vertical sides, and a shallow pointed bottom. Thick chunky light golden oak/caramel wood bevel frame, cool slate-metal corner fasteners, warm gold beveled details. A broad blank muted deep burgundy inset face; the face should be plain and quiet with generous usable uninterrupted interior area for real text, photos and logos to be overlaid later. Subtly scuffed stylized game materials and soft bright modeled lighting, clean readable silhouette.
Composition: one placard centered, nearly filling canvas with a narrow transparent margin. Full object visible, no cropping. Exterior is genuinely transparent alpha; preserve the opaque burgundy interior face.
Constraints: NO scenery, background, floor, opaque backdrop, checkerboard drawn in image, text, letters, runes, logos, emblems, symbols, people, characters, swords, crossed weapons, crowns, torches, or extra decorations. No ribbons or side banners. This must be an empty reusable card, with completely blank burgundy face and transparent outside.
